tagline: Yoga, Ganga aarti, rafting and Himalayan foothills
signatureFood: aloo puri, chole bhature, sattvic thali, cafe breakfasts

seasons.label: Spring and early summer
seasons.note: Warm days and the main rafting season; book rafting and yoga retreats ahead.

seasons.label: Monsoon
seasons.note: Rafting is typically suspended from mid-June to mid-September; landslide risk on hill roads.

seasons.label: Cool season
seasons.note: Clear and comfortable for yoga, temples and sightseeing; chilly mornings and nights.

places.name: Laxman Jhula and Riverside Walk
places.desc: Iconic pedestrian suspension bridge over the Ganga, with cafes and craft shops on both banks.

places.name: Ram Jhula and Parmarth Niketan
places.desc: Bridge and ashram complex with riverside ghats, meditation spaces and a large Shiva statue.

places.name: Evening Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat
places.desc: Riverside fire ritual with bhajans and floating lamps at sunset.

places.name: White-Water Rafting (16 km)
places.desc: Grade II-III Ganga rapids from Shivpuri to Rishikesh with optional cliff jumping; suspended in monsoon.

places.name: Beatles Ashram (Chaurasi Kutia)
places.desc: Abandoned ashram where the Beatles stayed in 1968, now covered in murals and graffiti.

places.name: Neer Garh Waterfall Trek
places.desc: Short forest walk to a tiered waterfall with natural pools.

places.name: Kunjapuri Temple Sunrise
places.desc: Hilltop temple reached by a steep drive, famous for sunrise views of the Himalayan range.

places.name: Ganga-side Yoga and Meditation Session
places.desc: Drop-in hatha yoga and meditation class with a certified teacher near the river.

places.name: Bungee Jump and Giant Swing
places.desc: India's highest fixed-platform bungee (83 m) with a giant swing and flying fox, at premium prices.

places.name: Riverside Cafe Hopping
places.desc: Laid-back cafes serving wood-fired pizza, bakery items, smoothies and sattvic thalis with river views.
